description: Israel's principal river, flowing from the Sea of Galilee to the Dead Sea and forming much of the eastern boundary of the promised land. Israel crossed it on dry ground entering Canaan (Joshua 3), Naaman was healed of leprosy after washing in it seven times at Elisha's instruction (2 Kings 5:1-14), and John the Baptist baptized Jesus in its waters (Matthew 3:13-17).
family_friendly_summary: The Jordan River is Israel's main river, flowing from the Sea of Galilee down to the Dead Sea. God stopped its waters so Israel could cross into the promised land on dry ground. Naaman was healed of a skin disease after washing in it seven times, and John the Baptist baptized Jesus in the Jordan.
